entries.what_it_does: Maps a protein FASTA query to UGO orthogroups, candidate modules, UGO scores, biological discovery cases, and validation-priority annotations.
entries.best_for: Researchers starting from a cloned gene, protein sequence, homolog candidate, or protein FASTA from a non-model species.

entries.entry_point: I have a DEG/QTL/GWAS gene list
entries.what_it_does: Maps user gene lists to UGO candidate modules and ranked module summaries.
entries.best_for: Researchers with RNA-seq DEGs, QTL interval genes, GWAS peak candidates, or manually curated candidate lists.

entries.what_it_does: Provides species-centered resource cards with available candidate modules, resource layers, and recommended next steps.
entries.best_for: Researchers who want to know what UGO-Omics can provide for a target species.

entries.what_it_does: Provides organ-centered candidate modules, biological overview, suggested validation focus, and recommended workflows.
entries.best_for: Researchers studying rhizome, tuber, storage root, bulb, corm, root crown, or stolon systems.
